instructions: Process in listed order: inspect the reference image before each edit.
Keep generated images in their specified project output paths; preserve alpha.
Inspect identity, orientation, margins, pose and frame registration before marking an image delivered.
Availability requires reviewed files and delivery recipes; a prompt does not constitute delivery.
Wrapped variants depend on acceptance of the matching barefoot source.

Avoid flat vector or SVG-like geometry.

WALK ANIMATION SPRITE STRIP: instead of one square pose, create ONE very wide transparent image containing exactly FOUR equally spaced full-body poses in a SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of four EQUAL WIDTH cells. No labels, no dividing lines. Same character and same pixel scale in all four cells, same head height and foot baseline. Facing RIGHT in every cell. Cell 1 left: walk contact, near leg forward, far leg back, opposite arm swing. Cell 2: passing pose, far knee moving forward, near leg straight on ground. Cell 3: opposite contact, far leg forward, near leg back, opposite arm swing. Cell 4: opposite passing pose, near knee moving forward, far leg straight on ground. Each figure centered within its own cell with 15% empty left/right margins, no body part crosses a cell boundary. No ghosts, no motion trails, no floor. Four poses exactly, readable as flipbook animation. Prioritize frame registration and matching proportions.
